agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #14 (day navigation + week strip) on branch ant/issue-14: added in-memory selectedDay state, prev/next/Today navigation buttons, a fixed-Monday-start week strip marking selected/today/has-work without color alone, and fixed the midnight-rollover defect by deriving the write-target day key at render/action time via an activeDay()/followingToday mechanism instead of a module-load constant. Added pure date helpers to state.js (parseKey, addDays, weekStart, weekKeys, dayHasWork), updated index.html/styles.css for the nav+strip UI (verified no horizontal scroll at 360px via screenshot), and appended 12 new Playwright tests (including a faked-clock midnight test) — all 21 tests pass, all 9 original tests unmodified. Appended a decision entry to DECISIONS.md covering the in-memory selection, no-timer midnight fix, fixed-Monday week boundary choice, and non-color-only markers. Opened PR #15 closing #14.
